shared_changes: Versioned experimental sanitizer redacts short sensitive path assignments including percent-encoded keys; frozen runtime is unchanged.
Scheme-free representation conflicts are quarantined using fit labels only; consistent fit duplicates retain the smallest original digest. No automatic relabeling.
Refit original v6 TF-IDF and numeric scaling recipe using curated fit rows only. Shared encoder for all three candidates.

Source-square-root weights are normalized to mean one. Source-class variant additionally equalizes class mass within each source. Hard-segments variant doubles weights for fit phishing URLs over 120 scheme-free characters and fit benign private-hosting tenants.

selection.improvement_requirement: macro recall >= frozen v6 tune control + 0.02 and no source recall delta below -0.05
selection.fallback: evaluate best development candidate as exploratory even if improvement requirement fails; never promote automatically

thresholds.selection: lowest threshold satisfying all source empirical negative budgets; ties conservative

protocol.benchmark_policy: After selecting and saving candidate, score it and original frozen v6 once on both already-observed benchmarks. Report all regressions without further candidate selection or tuning.
limitations: Existing development and benchmarks have prior exposure; this run cannot establish new independent generalization or Indonesian validation.
Labels retain publisher provenance and are not new human-reviewed gold labels.
Historical benign and recent positive-only feed remain separate distributions; positive-only FPR, precision and binary accuracy are unavailable.
Sanitizer remains heuristic and does not establish full anonymization.
Research noncommercial use only; API stays frozen v6 shadow with production_ready=false.
